//: CommonJS output, deliberately. ts-proto emits extensionless relative imports, which ESM under
Node rejects; CommonJS resolves them, is what @grpc/grpc-js itself ships, and is importable
from ESM consumers through Node's interop. The cost is one module-system generation behind
the fashion; the benefit is that no consumer needs a bundler or a loader flag.
`strict` plus the four extra checks below is half of this module's bug-finding (the other half
is the type-aware eslint rules in eslint.config.mjs, which need the project reference this
file provides). They are on for the generated stubs too: protoc's output is compiled code
here, not a vendored blob, so it either type-checks or the generator options are wrong.
